# ExamSage synthetic reference course

This directory intentionally contains no binary course material. The acceptance
suite generates the reference pack at runtime so the repository does not ship
third-party or copyrighted teaching content.

License: CC0-1.0. All generated words, questions, diagrams, formulas, tables,
images, and metadata are synthetic test data created for ExamSage.

The generated pack contains:

- a Markdown syllabus linking limits to continuity;
- a JSON past paper testing limits before continuity;
- a presentation with a labelled graph and formula;
- a 120-page PDF whose pages repeat the synthetic course relationship;
- a minimal OOXML spreadsheet containing a formula and displayed value;
- a generated scan-style PNG;
- a safe ZIP preview that is deliberately excluded before approval.

Expected relationship: **limits are a prerequisite for continuity**, and both
belong to the synthetic calculus course group. The pack is deterministic apart
from container metadata that does not affect its asserted educational content.
